comments.author: defrost
comments.story: Study: 77% of young Americans too fat, mentally ill, on drugs to join military
comments.why: British soldiers were once ordered to take LSD.
comments.text: Oddly enough if you joined the British Army in days of yore you might have found yourself ordered to take LSD. [VIDEO] ( Likely also true for other countries, eg: USofA, etc )

comments.author: stef25
comments.story: Russia deploys a mystery munition in Ukraine
comments.why: Footage of British soldiers dosed with LSD during drills.
comments.text: The British army actually dosed soldiers with LSD to see how they'd perform in drills. Needless to say the result was hilarious (climbing trees to feed the birds, incapable of reading maps) [VIDEO] Not sure if I'd trust people tripping around ballistic missiles though. These guys have been living in rough conditions, underfed and sleep deprived ... not the best "setting".
